_comment: Blocks an Age's sea may not be made of, though the sea's rule would allow them -- see
`Materials.makesASea`. The rule refuses a block entity, anything not a whole cube, and any block that checks what it stands on,
because a sea fills a volume over stone and caves, and a block that cannot stand there breaks and drops
itself: a sea of bamboo became tens of thousands of items. What the rule cannot see is behaviour over
time, which is what this file is for. Another mod's block that breaks, drops or spreads on its own
Leaves decay where no log stands near, and drop as they go. Ice and frosted ice are not here: they
melt in the light and drop nothing.
